type.title: Row type
type.description: financials (one company-period, charged) or status (a free row explaining a miss).

query.title: Query
query.description: The company exactly as given in the input.

status.title: Status
status.description: found (charged), not_found, ambiguous, no_xbrl_data, no_periods, duplicate, service_unavailable, skipped_charge_limit. Only found rows are charged.

cik.title: CIK
cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the filer.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Entity name as filed with the SEC.

sicDescription.title: SIC description
sicDescription.description: Industry description for the SIC code.

fiscalYearEnd.title: Fiscal year end (MMDD)
fiscalYearEnd.description: Fiscal year end month and day.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year as labelled by the company.

fiscalPeriod.title: Fiscal period
fiscalPeriod.description: FY, Q1, Q2, Q3 or Q4.

form.title: Form
form.description: Original report for the period: 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F or 40-F.

filed.title: Filed
filed.description: Date the original report was filed.

accessionNumber.title: Accession number
accessionNumber.description: EDGAR accession number of the original report.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Reporting currency (USD for US GAAP filers; IFRS filers may report e.g. TWD or EUR).

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Total revenue (net sales). In currency units; null if not reported.

costOfRevenue.title: Cost of revenue
costOfRevenue.description: Cost of goods and services sold. In currency units; null if not reported.

grossProfit.title: Gross profit
grossProfit.description: Revenue minus cost of revenue. In currency units; null if not reported.

researchAndDevelopment.title: R&D expense
researchAndDevelopment.description: Research and development expense. In currency units; null if not reported.

sellingGeneralAdmin.title: SG&A expense
sellingGeneralAdmin.description: Selling, general and administrative expense. In currency units; null if not reported.

operatingIncome.title: Operating income
operatingIncome.description: Operating income (loss). In currency units; null if not reported.

netIncome.title: Net income
netIncome.description: Net income (loss) attributable to the parent. In currency units; null if not reported.

epsBasic.title: EPS basic
epsBasic.description: Basic earnings per share. Null for derived Q4 rows (not additive).

epsDiluted.title: EPS diluted
epsDiluted.description: Diluted earnings per share. Null for derived Q4 rows (not additive).

dilutedSharesWeighted.title: Diluted shares (weighted)
dilutedSharesWeighted.description: Weighted average diluted shares outstanding for the period.

operatingCashFlow.title: Operating cash flow
operatingCashFlow.description: Net cash from operating activities. Null if not reported.

capitalExpenditure.title: Capital expenditure
capitalExpenditure.description: Payments for property, plant and equipment (positive number). Null if not reported.

cashAndEquivalents.title: Cash and equivalents
cashAndEquivalents.description: Cash and cash equivalents at period end. Null if not reported.

totalAssets.title: Total assets
totalAssets.description: Total assets at period end. Null if not reported.

totalLiabilities.title: Total liabilities
totalLiabilities.description: Total liabilities at period end (derived from liabilities and equity when not tagged). Null if not reported.

stockholdersEquity.title: Stockholders' equity
stockholdersEquity.description: Equity attributable to the parent at period end. Null if not reported.

longTermDebt.title: Long-term debt
longTermDebt.description: Non-current long-term debt at period end. Null if not reported.

freeCashFlow.title: Free cash flow
freeCashFlow.description: operatingCashFlow minus capitalExpenditure. Null if not reported.

revenueGrowthYoY.title: Revenue growth YoY
revenueGrowthYoY.description: Revenue vs the same period one year earlier (0.15 = +15%). Null when the prior period is not in SEC data.

derivedMetrics.title: Derived metrics
derivedMetrics.description: Metrics computed by subtraction (Q4 = FY minus 9 months, quarterly cash flow from year-to-date, gross profit, liabilities).

restated.title: Restated
restated.description: true if a later filing changed any value for this period; values shown are the latest.

metricsFound.title: Metrics found
metricsFound.description: How many of the 17 standard metrics had a value.

sources.title: XBRL sources
sources.description: Only with includeSources: metric -> XBRL concept used.

filingUrl.title: Filing URL
filingUrl.description: EDGAR index page of the original report.

secFactsUrl.title: SEC facts URL
secFactsUrl.description: SEC companyfacts JSON the values came from.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: For ambiguous names: up to 5 matching filers (cik, ticker, name).

error.title: Error
error.description: Why a status row was not answered and what to try. Null on found rows.
examples: No SEC filer matches "Acme Robotics". Not charged.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: When the row was produced (ISO 8601 UTC).
